name: ChainForge
title: system
constraints: Opening the UI can work without paid credentials, generating responses requires a configured provider. Monorepo and optional RAG extras complicate installation.

name: hypocompass
title: system
constraints: README suggests Node 16. Backend and frontend must both start. Do not infer credential requirement from an installed OpenAI client alone.

name: generative_agents
title: system
constraints: Replay and new simulation are distinct workflows. New simulation makes paid model calls, UI health alone does not validate agent behavior.

name: storm
title: system
constraints: Core package and nested demo have distinct entry points. Cloud search and model credentials are needed for the corresponding article-generation example.

name: dspy
title: cli_script
constraints: Library import is a different contract from a web server. Selecting a usage example is necessary for a functional test.

name: autogen
title: tool
constraints: Must choose a component such as Studio. Installing a root monorepo or importing the framework does not start the GUI.

name: SWE-agent
title: tool
constraints: Launching the inspector does not prove an agent completed a coding task. Running tasks executes external code and consumes configured model resources.

name: WorkArena
title: system
constraints: Gated remote service access is an expected prerequisite. The HF artifact contains instance access information, not a replacement for a ServiceNow deployment.

name: webarena
title: system
constraints: Multi-container environment and external images. Native-only preview support cannot be interpreted as full benchmark compatibility.

name: vega-lite
title: visualization
constraints: A successful compiler build is not a server. Jekyll site dependencies are additional to the JavaScript library.

name: voyager
title: tool
constraints: This is the original Voyager repository, not the Voyager 2 paper. Legacy Bower/Gulp compatibility is an intentional stress case.

name: draco2
title: visualization
constraints: Core solver usage and optional HTTP API are separate workflows. A correct diagnosis can be library-only or require the server extra.

name: wizmap
title: system
constraints: Viewing existing embeddings and creating embeddings are different tasks, model inference is not required for the viewer itself.

name: bertviz
title: tool
constraints: Notebook output is not a standalone web application. Visualizing supplied attention tensors can avoid downloading a model.

name: lit
title: system
constraints: Choose a documented demo or model wrapper. HTTP health does not verify salience/model computations.

name: ecco
title: tool
constraints: Notebook-first library, do not require an HTTP listener to recognize it. Older model APIs can fail against newer Transformers releases.

name: mesa
title: simulation
constraints: A specific example model must be selected for visualization. The current source runtime floor differs from older Mesa releases.

name: Gymnasium
title: simulation
constraints: Core environment reset/step can run headlessly. Rendering or all-extras installation introduces additional platform requirements.

name: Minigrid
title: tool
constraints: README officially supports Linux/macOS and does not claim Windows support. Grid stepping and interactive rendering are distinct checks.

name: overcooked_ai
title: simulation
constraints: Tight Python pin and optional training GPU stack. A running demo does not prove human-AI coordination results reproduce.

name: mujoco
title: tool
constraints: Desktop/OpenGL rendering differs from a web preview. Source compilation and pip wheels are different setup paths.

name: jsPsych
title: tool
constraints: Do not mistake a documentation server for an experiment. Build/release example assets must resolve for a meaningful browser check.

name: moabb
title: tool
constraints: Downloads vary greatly across EEG datasets. Repository checkout does not include the raw recordings or establish cross-subject reproducibility.

name: mne-python
title: tool
constraints: Headless numerical analysis and desktop 3D visualization have different dependency requirements.

name: braindecode
title: tool
constraints: Model construction can be tested without large data, reproducing EEG decoding results requires data and a specified evaluation pipeline.

name: SWE-bench
title: tool
constraints: Full harness runs are storage-intensive, a small dataset read is not a successful patch evaluation. ARM image setup differs from x86.

name: human-eval
title: cli_package
constraints: Repository deliberately disables execution by default pending explicit setup. Dataset inspection is a separate check from executing generated code.

name: grade-school-math
title: dataset_in_git
constraints: Intentional incomplete-manifest case. Treat dataset availability independently of training-code executability.

name: test
title: cli_script
constraints: This records the original external distribution even though mirrors exist elsewhere. Archive retrieval and evaluation are separate stages.

name: natural-instructions
title: dataset_in_git
constraints: Large task collection with source-specific data licenses. Cloning and checking JSON do not reproduce cross-task generalization.

name: Tk-Instruct
title: tool
constraints: Paired with natural-instructions-data to test one paper with multiple repositories. HF artifact here is model weights, not an HF dataset.

name: diffusiondb
title: dataset_in_hf
constraints: Use a bounded subset, full data retrieval is not a reasonable smoke test. Detect README dependencies omitted from requirements.txt.

name: scifact
title: dataset_external
constraints: Old binary dependencies stress modern Python/Apple Silicon. Data download, model loading and claim verification need distinct outcomes.

name: sentence-transformers
title: cli_script
constraints: Repository moved from UKPLab to Hugging Face. Current package differs from the original 2019 implementation, reviewed revision is recorded.

name: lm-evaluation-harness
title: tool
constraints: Paper is Lessons from the Trenches, written by harness developers,do not substitute the software Zenodo DOI for its paper DOI. Task/model/configuration must accompany any score.

name: datasets
title: tool
constraints: Library is not a single dataset. Use a specified small public dataset/revision for functional testing, load success is not model evaluation.

name: faiss
title: cli_script
constraints: Native source build and precompiled CPU wheels are different cases. Synthetic-vector smoke tests avoid billion-vector dataset downloads.

name: seaborn
title: visualization
constraints: A static generated plot is a valid artifact, absence of a long-running server is expected.

name: umap
title: visualization
constraints: Numba JIT warmup affects first-run latency. Local data transformation and optional plotting need separate checks.

name: post--feature-visualization
title: visualization
constraints: Serving committed visualization assets does not regenerate neural feature images. Legacy source rebuild is a different, harder case.
